readerCopy.body: A sudden break from expectation can make a long-suppressed preference or refusal impossible to keep pretending is irrelevant. When Uranus conjoins Lilith, disruption and autonomy fuse, making an unconventional choice, changed rule, abrupt exit, or private desire move quickly into the open. The break can create freedom and collateral damage at the same time. The strongest change is the one that releases the actual restriction without requiring chaos to prove that the old expectation has lost its authority.
